# catalystcenter_map_archive_import (Resource)

This resource imports a Catalyst Center map archive (tar.gz) containing xmlDir/MapsImportExport.xml plus floor images under /images. It orchestrates start import, pre-import validation, and perform import. <p/> The archive must be Cisco's XML interchange format (for example an Ekahau Cloud Project Export via API). Raw Ekahau .esx files are not accepted by the Intent API. Sites (area, building, floor) named in the archive must already exist. Perform fully replaces existing map data (images, obstacles, planned APs) for those sites. <p/> Set archive_sha256 = filesha256(source_path): re-apply is a no-op while the archive is unchanged, and changing the file or source_path replaces the resource and imports again. Destroy removes the resource from state only; Catalyst Center map data is left in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "catalystcenter_map_archive_import" "example" {
  source_path      = "testdata/map_archives/nac_map_import.tar.gz"
  accept_data_loss = true
  archive_sha256   = "11052e417e1a8b0f763bc363c4cb994be3c0330f33afba927a6a402c6e2a0364"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `accept_data_loss` (Boolean) Must be true. Acknowledges that perform import fully replaces existing map data for the site(s) defined in the archive.
- `archive_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the archive file, normally filesha256(source_path). Changing it replaces the resource and imports the archive again. Apply fails before the upload when the file does not match.
- `source_path` (String) Local path to a Catalyst Center map archive tar.gz (xmlDir/MapsImportExport.xml plus images/). Ekahau .esx files are not supported.

### Optional

- `import_context_uuid` (String) Import context UUID returned by start import. Retained after a successful import for troubleshooting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
